issue.title: Regression: qos/qos_sai_base.py resetWatermark fixture assumes all LCs on a Chassis are Multi-Asic

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

202511

### Steps to Reproduce

tests/qos/qos_sai_base.py has recently been updated and changed resetWatermark fixture which uses counterpoll CLI to enable watermark and queue counters, followed by disabling them.

This fixture incorrectly assumes that if the first Linecard of a chassis is multi asic then they all are and it then incorrectly uses the counterpoll CLI to enable and disable these counters on each linecard.

Introduced by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/20544

Very similar to https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/23998

### Impact of this regression

MGMT tests fail on multi asic chassis.

resolution.title: fix resetWatermark QoS fixture on chassis
resolution.description:
tests/qos/test_qos_sai.py are failing on a chassis that has both a multi asic and a single asic linecard.
This commit fixes the issue and provides a general code improvement.

This is a very similar issue as solved by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/23999 but for a different fixture.
